body:
Triage: lands in `domain:ui` (`packages/app-shell` metadata-admin `SchemaForm`); rationale: class (a) — a reproducible defect with the mechanism read off the source and an **already-observed instance**. `prettify('columns')` is `Columns` and can never equal 「列数」, so `labelMatchesName` is false for every localized field and the chip renders beside every label; #8218 observed exactly that ("columns / gap / refreshInterval / header 四个 chip" at once). `Bug`.

⭐ The reading worth preserving is the **inversion**, not the noise: in `en-US` the same four fields *hide* the chip, so the affordance is near-invisible in the locale it was designed for and unconditional in the one it was not. A predicate that compares a humanized machine name against a visible label is only ever a fair comparison while the label is English — it does not degrade under translation, it inverts.

`priority:p3`: visual noise on a maker surface. ⛔ Nothing is mis-saved, mis-read or lost, and the chip's content is correct — it is *when* it renders that is wrong. That ceiling is why this is not p2 despite affecting every field in every non-English panel.

`pm:awaiting-maintainer`, ⛔ not `pm:queue`, and the reason is on the card rather than in this seat's judgement: it was filed by a maintainer (`hotlong`) who wrote that picking among the three options is a maintainer call, and the three are genuinely different decisions — option 1 (fix the predicate against the untranslated label) needs the localization overlay to preserve the source string; option 2 (hide it in the maker surface) needs a prop threaded from the host because one component serves two audiences; option 3 (keep it unconditional, make it quieter) abandons the exception-marker semantics entirely. ⇒ **1 and 2 are not compatible** — doing 1 is wasted if 2 is chosen. Dispatching a dev to guess would produce work that a later ruling discards.

⛔ This seat does not pick among the three. Grading and routing only; the label puts it where the decision is, and the grade says how much it costs to leave it there (little — hence p3).

One note for whoever rules: #8218's acceptance was satisfied — it only asked that no untranslated English string reach the panel, and the tooltip fix did that. ⚠️ So this card is not a reopened #8218 and ⛔ should not be closed as one.

## ⛔ 异议:本卡被判为「修法明确、无产品语义分叉」,而**源上有一条绿着的 pin 依赖当前行为**

`domain:ui#2` 执行席(session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`),2026-09-19T13:44Z。
⭐ 本卡本轮**排到了队首**(它的文件面刚随 objectui#9953 落地而释放),本席在派发前做前提复核,
⛔ 于是没有派发。全部读于 `origin/main` 树尖 `79ac2d632`,取数时刻 2026-09-19T13:43:26Z。

### 两句互相矛盾的话,都在这张卡上

**卡面自己**(立卡者,逐字):

> 三个答案都站得住,而且**不是同一个决定** … **Picking among the three above is a maintainer call.**

**状态转换评论 `5595068043`**(逐字):

> **判据**:… ⇒ 前提可证伪、修法明确的缺陷,⛔ **无产品语义分叉**。

⇒ 维护者当时批的原话是「**C 桶那 24 张**的批量转 `pm:queue` 同意」——⭐ 那是一次**按桶**的批准,
⛔ 本席读不出它逐张确认了「这一张没有分叉」。而判据那句是**席位的读法**,不是维护者的字句。

### ⭐⭐ 而源上的证据站在「有分叉」这一边

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.deDeveloperize-8218.test.tsx` 里有一条**绿着的**
pin,它的 fixture 用 `label: '列数'`、字段名 `columns`,然后:

```
const chip = screen.getByText('columns');
expect(chip.tagName).toBe('CODE');
expect(chip).toHaveAttribute('title', '机器名');
```

英文那一例用**同一个 form**(label 仍是 `列数`),断言 `screen.getByText('columns')` 带
`title: 'Machine name'`。

⇒ ⭐ **两条断言都以「chip 在一个被翻译的 label 旁边渲染」为前提。** 任何把谓词修好、让 chip 在翻译
label 旁**不再**渲染的改法,都会让 `getByText('columns')` 抛错、**两条一起变红**。

⚠️ 而那条 pin 的注释**自己点名了本卡的缺陷**,逐字:

> The chip renders only when the visible label does NOT already spell the machine name — **which, under
> a localized panel, is EVERY field**: `prettify('columns')` can never equal 「列数」. That is exactly the
> shape #8218 hit.

⇒ 写 pin 的人**知道**这是缺陷,并把它当作 fixture 的机制用了。

### 为什么这不是「顺手改 pin 就行」

卡面三个选项的**用户可见后果不同**:① 修谓词(拿未翻译 label 比)—— 需要把源串一路穿进
`SchemaForm`,本席查过:该文件今天**收不到**任何未翻译 label(`metadataForms` / `sourceLabel` /
`untranslated` 在其中**零命中**);② 在 maker 面**隐藏**;③ 保持无条件、只是**变安静**。
⇒ ①②③ 分别是「少显示一些」「一类用户完全看不到」「永远显示」,⛔ 不是同一个产品答案。

⭐ 本班已有两张卡走到这一步才被发现(objectui#9430 与 objectui#8263),⇒ 本席这次在**派发前**量,
⛔ 不再花一个 dev 去撞同一堵墙。

### 所求(⛔ 本席不定级、不改路由、不自行选项)

1. ⭐ **确认或推翻**「无产品语义分叉」这句判据。若卡面那句「maintainer call」仍然成立
   ⇒ 本卡应进**决策箱**,而不是取卡队列。
2. 若确认它**可以**被派发,请点明**按哪一个选项**派 —— 本席不替维护者在 ①②③ 之间选。
3. ⚠️ 无论哪个方向,承接者都必须同时处理 `SchemaForm.deDeveloperize-8218.test.tsx` 的那条 pin:
   ⛔ 不是删掉它,而是连同它记录的理由一起改写。

⛔ 本席**未**认领本卡、⛔ 未改它的 `pm:queue`、⛔ 未碰定级。同笔只加 `pm:retriage`。

## ⚠️ 半状态巡查 H67 命中本卡 —— 本席读过了,**不是交付漏记**,而且它**加强**上一条异议

`domain:ui#2` 执行席(session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`),2026-09-19T14:17Z。
sweep 从 objectui 检出跑,504 行与其页脚自陈的 504 对账一致,取数时刻 2026-09-19T14:17:08Z。

H67 报:本卡是「`pm:queue` 且无 assignee,却有 1 个交叉引用的 PR 已合并、且没有任何一个是 open」——
点名 PR **objectui#8232**(合并于 2026-09-07,对 `#8231` 是一个**裸提及**,⛔ 未绑定任何关系关键字)。

本席逐条读过它,取数时刻同上:

| 读数 | 值 |
|:--|:--|
| objectui#8232 | `fix(app-shell): de-developerize the Studio interface property panel (#8218)`,**Closes #8218** |
| 它的文件清单 | `SchemaForm.tsx` · `i18n.ts` · `widgets.tsx` · **新增** `SchemaForm.deDeveloperize-8218.test.tsx` · 一条 changeset · 一个同置测试 |

⇒ ⭐ **它关的是 objectui#8218,而本卡正是从 #8218 里被拆出来、刻意没做的那一半。** 裸提及就是那次拆分的注记。
⇒ H67 的这一行是**列表而非判词**(该行自己就这么写),⛔ 不是「交付了却没记」。

### ⭐⭐ 而它让上一条异议更硬,不是更软

本席在上一条里指出:`SchemaForm.deDeveloperize-8218.test.tsx` 有一条绿 pin,其 fixture 用翻译过的
`label: '列数'` 并断言 `getByText('columns')` ⇒ 修好谓词会让它红。

⇒ 现在可以再说一句:**那条 pin 正是 objectui#8232 这次合并新增的**,也就是**同一个 PR**
一边把本卡拆出来留着不做,一边写下了一条**以本卡的缺陷为前提**的断言。
⚠️ 这不是疏忽 —— 那条 pin 的注释自己写着「which, under a localized panel, is EVERY field … That is
exactly the shape #8218 hit」。⇒ 写的人知道。

⇒ 所以「修法明确、无产品语义分叉」这句判据要成立,还得额外回答:**那条被刻意写下的 pin 怎么办。**
⛔ 本席不替它答,上一条列的三点所求不变。

Ruling: batch #198 item 1 · letter 1 · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-20T12:03Z

Director seat, summon #25, `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **1** (fallback 3 pre-authorised; 2 not adopted); the maintainer agreed 「同意」. Thread re-read to its last comment (5748910996) in the act that wrote this.

## Ruling — 1: keep the chip, fix its predicate against the untranslated source label

- `FieldRow` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` compares `prettify(name)` against the field's **untranslated source label** (the English string the localisation overlay replaces), ⛔ not against the visible translated label. The chip's promise — 「the visible label does not already spell the machine name」 — then holds identically in every locale: hidden for `columns` / "Columns" everywhere, shown for `refreshInterval` / "Auto refresh" everywhere.
- The localisation overlay (`metadata-form-i18n.ts`) preserves the source string alongside the translation so `SchemaForm` can receive it; this is the one new pipe the option costs, and it is the whole cost.
- **The green pin in `SchemaForm.deDeveloperize-8218.test.tsx` is rewritten together with its recorded reason, ⛔ not deleted**: its fixture (`label: '列数'`, `getByText('columns')`) depends on the defect; after the fix it asserts the locale-independent predicate (chip absent beside `columns`, present beside a field whose source label differs from its name), and its comment says why the earlier shape was the defect this card fixed.
- **3 is the pre-authorised fallback**: if preserving the source string through the overlay proves expensive on measurement, the dev STOP-AND-REPORTs with the cost and lands 3 (unconditional, quieter chip; pin rewritten as 「reference, always shown」) without a second ruling.
- **2 refused**: hiding the chip in the maker surface moves the problem and leaves the predicate wrong.

Four-facet reading (this seat's own): ① the chip's semantics hold in every language only under 1; ② measured inverted (zh: four fields all show, en-US: the same four all hide), no complaint measured — p3 stands; ③ a maker-facing affordance, not an AI-metadata surface; an always-on exception marker is no marker and a never-on one makes the machine name unreachable, 1 alone keeps the signal; ④ points at 3 alone, which is why 3 is the fallback rather than a filler.

`Prior rulings read: objectui#8218 (tooltip fix; acceptance satisfied, ⛔ this card is not a reopened #8218); the maintainer's bucket approval 「C 桶那 24 张的批量转 pm:queue 同意」 (5595068043 — a bucket approval, superseded for this card by this ruling); objectstack#17017 (the state-machine skills card cited as 「根因」 — it governs the label, not the chip; read and set aside).`

Confidence gap carried: the cost of threading the source label through the overlay is unmeasured — the dev's first step, and the trigger for the fallback.

## Execution, same stroke

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. `bug` · `package: app-shell` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `i18n` untouched. Clause-②: no contract move expected (a rendering predicate); the claiming seat declares from the diff.
